name: tab-close-narrow-group
description: A narrow 200px Dockview group truncates a long tab title so the active tab's close action stays inside the group and hit-testable.

mutation.declaration: shell/dockview-theme.css: remove the narrow-tab max-width / ellipsis / flex-shrink: 0 rules for .dv-tab, .dv-default-tab-content, and .dv-default-tab-action
mutation.note: Verified 2026-11-19 at 200px group width. Without the dockview-theme.css rules, fails with: close action [495.5, 515.5] escapes 200px group [0.0, 200.0]; tab right 523.5px escapes group right 200.0px; tab title did not truncate (scrollWidth=479, clientWidth=479); close center hit neighbor-content instead of inspector-close. With the rules applied, passes with close [172.0, 192.0] inside [0.0, 200.0] and title truncated 156/479px.
